title: Set down what's not yours
subtitle: A quiet closing: release the burden a part carried, keep the part.

steps.body:
When you've met a part and seen what it carried, there's a quiet step left.

Not throwing the part away — it stays. Setting down the burden it carried for you. The weight was never really yours to hold forever.

steps.title: What has this part been carrying for you?
steps.body: A belief, a fear, a role, a weight handed to you long ago that you've been holding ever since.

Read it back, once. Then let it go — out loud, on the breath, or just in your chest.

Some people write it on paper and burn it later. The gesture is yours to choose; none of it is required.

steps.title: And what's yours to keep?
steps.body: The part itself. The need underneath. What it was trying to protect all along.

exit.body: You didn't throw anything away. You set down a weight, and kept what's yours. The shift shows up in how you live — not in how you feel in this exact moment.
